# Daily notes — Thistlewick diagnostic prep

Today's sessions settled the Thistlewick diagnostic plan. The diagnostic runs for two weeks and starts with interviews in the warehouse team before anyone in management. The interview guide drops the maturity-scale questions, because they produced vague answers last time. The readout goes to the operations director first, then to the steering group.

Still open: whether the second week includes a visit to the Leeds depot.
